description: Defines a sample analysis, which may include multiple results.

sentBy.description: The party sending the sample for analysis.

analysedBy.description: The laboratory or other party responsible for carrying out the analysis.

sampleExternalIdentifier.description: External identifier of the sample being analysed (provided by the requesting or sending party).

sampleInternalIdentifier.description: Internal identifier of the sample being analysed (used within the analysing organization).

sampleSessionIdentifier.description: Identifier of the sample session or batch associated with the analysis.

samplingDateTime.description: Date and time when the sample was collected.

receiptDateTime.description: Date and time when the sample was received for analysis.

results.description: List of results obtained from the sample analysis.
